definitions.explanation: Items and supplies provided for use in an office, school, or other facility. Refers to durable goods that belong to an organization rather than to individuals.

examples.japanese: {備品|びひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{備品|びひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{私的|してき}→私的：06350_shiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not use company equipment for personal purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な{備品|びひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make a list of the equipment needed for the new office.

notes:
{備品|びひん} is composed of {備|び} (prepare, equip) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods, article).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {備品|びひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧: to manage equipment
- {備品|びひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase supplies
- {備品|びひん}⟦{台帳|だいちょう}→台帳：08001_daichou⟧: equipment ledger
- ⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧{備品|びひん}: office supplies/equipment

USAGE: Refers to durable items that belong to an organization — desks, chairs, projectors, etc. Consumable items like paper and pens are typically called ⟦{消耗品|しょうもうひん}→消耗品：09548_shoumouhin⟧ instead.
